title: Investigation of the Inhibition of IRE-1/XBP-1 Pathway in the Multiple Nematicidal Mechanisms of Isobavachalcone against Meloidogyne incognita.
authors: Zhao, Congqi; Zhang, Meifen; Chen, Shuang; Xiao, Xiang; Zhao, Hongmei; Jian, Qiang; Mo, Xiyuan; Shen, Guojing; Zhou, Wenbing; Li, Jiangzhou; Xu, Junju
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物IBC对线虫的杀线机制，涉及IRE-1蛋白的分子对接与动力学模拟，但对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: A natural compound isobavachalcone (IBC) from Crotalaria junceaexhibited an excellent nematicidal effect against Meloidogyne incognita, with an LC(50) value of 53.30 mg/L (24 h), which was validated through pot experiments. Further, a novel, multiple nematicidal mechanism of IBC was investigated. We discovered that it simultaneously induced oxidative stress and downregulated key lipid metabolism genes (e.g., fat-5, acox-1.2), leading to a significant reduction in triglyceride and fat content. Notably, IBC was also found to inhibit IRE-1/XBP-1 pathway of the endoplasmic reticulum unfolded protein response (UPR(ER)), as evidenced by suppressed IRE-1 phosphorylation, blocked XBP-1 splicing, and reduced expression of the endoplasmic reticulum chaperone gene hsp-4. Moreover, molecular docking and dynamics simulations confirmed that IBC stably bound to the ATP-binding pocket of IRE-1. Importantly, the inhibition of IRE-1/XBP-1 pathway was revealed for the first time in nematode lethality. These findings indicate its potential for development as a novel nematicide.
abstract_zh: 来自菘蓝（Crotalaria juncea）的天然化合物异黄酮查尔酮（IBC）对南方根结线虫（Meloidogyne incognita）表现出优异的杀线虫效果，其LC(50)值为53.30 mg/L（24小时），并通过盆栽试验得到验证。进一步研究了IBC的一种新型多重杀线虫机制。我们发现，它同时诱导氧化应激并下调关键脂质代谢基因（如fat-5、acox-1.2），导致甘油三酯和脂肪含量显著降低。值得注意的是，IBC还被发现抑制内质网未折叠蛋白反应（UPR(ER)）的IRE-1/XBP-1通路，这通过抑制IRE-1磷酸化、阻断XBP-1剪接以及降低内质网伴侣基因hsp-4的表达得到证实。此外，分子对接和动力学模拟确认IBC稳定结合于IRE-1的ATP结合口袋。重要的是，IRE-1/XBP-1通路的抑制在线虫致死性中首次被揭示。这些发现表明其具有开发为新型杀线虫剂的潜力。
